data.name: InventoryHint
data.value: An empty inventory uses 500 reviewed defaults. Availability is a snapshot; generation rechecks names and required elf builds. A few English names are intentional.

data.name: ApplyHint
data.value: Save updates the configuration only. Quantities and account ownership apply on the next coordinated bot startup, normally a planned restart of all game servers. Existing bot names and progress are preserved.

data.name: RotationHint
data.value: This is population capacity, not a guaranteed online count; presence rotation and server capacity still apply.

data.name: Additional
data.value: Add characters to the target

data.name: AdditionalHint
data.value: Use a multiple of the characters per account. This calculator changes the draft account target only.

data.name: Calculate
data.value: Set account target

data.name: AdditionalInvalid
data.value: Enter a positive multiple of the characters per account; the resulting account target must not exceed 1000.

data.name: Refresh
data.value: Refresh preview

data.name: Loading
data.value: Reading population and nickname availability…

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: The preview could not be read. Retry before saving; no changes were applied.

data.name: CannotSave
data.value: Resolve the preview errors before saving.

data.name: invalidInventory
data.value: The inventory contains duplicate, reserved or invalid names.

data.name: loginConflict
data.value: A generated bot login is occupied by a non-bot account. Adjust the target after resolving the conflict.

data.name: insufficientInventory
data.value: There are not enough unused reviewed names for the proposed new characters. Extend the inventory or lower the target.

data.name: MissingSlots
data.value: Existing accounts have missing selected slots. They are not backfilled; characters per account affects generation of new accounts.

data.name: ReduceHint
data.value: Reducing the target changes the next startup selection only. Surplus accounts and progress remain in the database.

data.name: Runtime
data.value: Startup status on each game server

data.name: NoRuntime
data.value: No in-process bot startup observations are available. This may be a distributed deployment or a plugin that has not run yet.

data.name: waiting

data.name: Pending

data.name: Failed
data.value: Generation failed; inspect the server logs

data.name: RetrySlots

data.name: Unsaved
data.value: The configuration has unsaved changes. Preview does not save or apply them.

data.name: Destructive
data.value: Rebuild/purge deletes existing bots. The non-destructive quantity preview below does not apply to deletion. Purge may run immediately after saving; rebuild runs at startup.
